The part of a tree that grows underground is the root.

The author's narrative style is characterized by an alternating first-person point of view, which allows the reader to experience the story through the distinct perspectives of different space expedition team members. The tone shifts dynamically between the optimistic and curious mindset of the scientist and the pragmatic, cautious outlook of the engineer. Additionally, the language varies from technical descriptions of machinery and phenomena to more reflective and philosophical musings on humanity's place in the universe.
